title: Zesty Crispy Jamaican Chicken Fried Rice
description: A flavorful and crispy weeknight Jamaican dish featuring chicken, cider, and fried rice.

ingredients.name: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add another tbsp of oil to the pot and cook the bell peppers until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked chicken back into the pot and stir in jerk seasoning, cumin, and cayenne pepper.
Add the fried rice to the pot and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Push the rice mixture to one side of the pot. Add the remaining oil to the empty side of the pot.
Pour in the reduced apple cider vinegar and bring to a simmer.
Scrape the bottom of the pot to release any browned bits. Stir the vinegar mixture into the rice mixture.
Stir in chopped scallions and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
